messages:
maya: FYI escalated ticket from AcmeOps — they ran a bulk SCIM import last night and a bunch of users who were removed from the Okta group are still active in Redwood. They say ~120 users should have been deprovisioned but remain.

lena: Ugh. Any errors in the webhook logs or our SCIM job?

maya: Attached screenshot in Zendesk, but quick dump from customer shows the DELETE Group membership events were sent. Our webhook acked 202. No obvious 4xx from their side.

samir: Can you paste the raw event we got for one of the affected users? I want to confirm whether it's a Group REMOVE or an expensive PATCH we ignore.

maya: Paste of one event (redacted):

```json
{
  \"schemas\": [\"urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp\"],
  \"Operations\": [
    {
      \"op\": \"remove\",
      \"path\": \"groups[value eq \"00g123\"]\"
    }
  ]
}
```

maya: That group id maps to role "viewer" in their mapping table.

eli: Two quick guesses: 1) our mapping engine matched on group name rather than externalId (so if they renamed the group it didn't match), or 2) the delta-sync worker failed to pick up the event due to rate-limiting and we silently retried without reconciling role deltas.

samir: @maya can you confirm if their group-to-role mapping uses `externalId` or `displayName`? We should be preferring `externalId` for idempotency.

maya: Support says they use displayName in the UI mapping (they configured "DevTeam" -> editor). They sent us the mapping CSV. Looks like they have two groups with same displayName (case diff) — one with externalId `00g123` and another `00g123-alt`.

samir: Bingo. That would explain stale roles: our current mapper runs a case-sensitive name match and picks the first matching rule. If the removed group had the alt externalId but same displayName, we might not have removed the role.

lena: Is that a customer config issue (bad mapping) or an engine bug?

samir: Combination. We should: 1) make mapper prefer externalId when available, 2) make name matching case-insensitive and deterministic if externalId missing, and 3) run a one-off reconciliation for the affected org. I'll prepare a patch.

eli: For immediate mitigation — run a reconciliation job against AcmeOps that recalculates roles from current SCIM state. Command: `./cli scim:reconcile --org acmeops --mode apply --limit 5000` (we normally run dry-run first).

maya: I have a Zendesk note with customer permission to run the job. I'll request dry-run first and share the diff.

samir: Also check the provisioning token scope. A separate incident earlier showed some deprovisioning requests returned 403 because token only had `provision:read` not `provision:write`. If the reconcile job needs write, ensure the org token has `provision:write`.

maya: Confirmed — their token has `provision:write`. No 403s in the last 72h for this org.

samir: Ok. I'll push a small mapping fix: prefer `externalId` and add case-insensitive fallback. PR: github.com/redwood/inference/ops/PR-4281. Planning quick patch to staging, then run reconcile.

eli: Add a transient alert for high ratio of "membership_remove" events acked but not resulting in role delta. We have a gap window metric but not this specific case.

lena: After reconcile, can we also give the customer a list of users changed and a rollback plan? They asked for auditability.

maya: Yes — dry-run will produce a CSV we can attach. I'll schedule a call with AcmeOps after we confirm the dry-run.

scim-sync-bot: job scim-reconcile-acmeops-178215 started (dry-run). Estimated time 2m.

samir: Following up — quick log snippet from the reconcile dry-run: `skipping group match by name because externalId present for mapping rule` and `queued 118 removals for role viewer`

maya: Sent dry-run CSV to customer — they confirmed the changes look right. Ok to apply?

lena: 👍 apply it and monitor. Please capture any 4xx/5xx and post here.

scim-sync-bot: job scim-reconcile-acmeops-178215 completed (apply run): applied 118 removals, 0 failures.

maya: Customer confirms those 118 accounts were deprovisioned in their app. Closing ticket after 24h check.

samir: I'll keep the mapping change in staging for 24h then merge to prod. Also adding a unit test for duplicate displayName handling and a migration note for orgs with legacy name-based mappings. PR updated: PR-4281 -> added tests.

eli: Added alert rule: `scim.reconcile_discrepancy_rate > 1% for 15m` and created runbook entry `runbooks/scim/mapping-conflicts.md`

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update Zendesk and mark as high-priority resolved once customer confirms 24h. :tada:
